section_summary.extract_value: This Methods section describes a single study (Study X) with 311 participants (195 women, 116 men) recruited from students and staff at two universities in São Paulo, Brazil. Participants had a mean age of 29.32 years and a mean self-reported BMI of 23.27 kg/m², with 79.4% identifying as White and 51.1% having college or higher education. The section provides demographic information but does not specify the survey method, body appreciation assessment instrument, or correlation results.
